entities.summary: The Carlos III Health Institute is a Spanish public health research institute, legally constituted as a public research agency, a type of quasi-autonomous entity under Spanish law. The ISCIII is integrated in the Department of Science and Innovation, although it also reports to the Department of Health in the institute's activities relating health, healthcare and its planning.
